comments.author: fillthenameinhere
comments.body_html: Overswing caused by low ergonomic, or specifically EvoErgo stat which is calculated by jingling some number between Ergo and the weight of the gun. So if you want your weapon not to overswing, just crank the ergo to the max then it should be good. You can visit db4tarkov in gun tab and mod some gun in that website for a better understanding. Tldr: Higher ergo = Good. Higher weight = Bad. High ergo + low weight > no overswing. Low Ergo + high Weight > yes overswing.
